## Professional Summary

Lead Automation Engineer with 10+ years building automation across multi-tenant IT operations and SMB client environments. Built workflow, endpoint, and Microsoft 365 automation across 500+ client environments and 4,000+ endpoints. Recent work: production inbound conversational AI agents (voice-first) on the ElevenLabs Agents platform, live across 5 client organizations spanning 20+ sites, with Twilio/Telnyx/Bandwidth telephony, n8n orchestration, real-time CRM enrichment, schema-validated webhook contracts, and a Vitest + synthetic-conversation regression harness that catches >90% of regressions before ship. Applied Technology Group was selected for an ElevenLabs Startup Grant in 2025 for this conversational-AI agent work.

## Operating Record

- 10+ years of IT operations and automation experience across automation, escalation, documentation, and live support environments.
- 500+ client environments supported; 4,000+ endpoints under script-driven management with manual oversight reduced ~40%.
- Workstation onboarding cut from 8 hours to 2 with an ImmyBot framework of 200-300 Python/PowerShell scripts, built from scratch and handed off as the senior team's standard tooling.
- 700-guide SOP and automation framework standardizing delivery; new-engineer ramp cut from ~3 months to ~1 as the engineering team grew from 10 to ~20.
- Inbound conversational AI agents (voice-first) in production across 5 client organizations spanning 20+ sites on the ElevenLabs Agents platform.
- n8n orchestration layer with schema-validated webhook contracts at every boundary.
- AI ticket dispatcher over the full ConnectWise PSA corpus: ticket triage cut from up to 4 hours to 5-10 minutes; a 3-4-person dispatch team shifted from manual triage to exception-handling.
- Vitest + synthetic-conversation evaluation harness gates every prompt change; catches >90% of regressions before ship and gates 100% of known cases.
- Microsoft Secure Score lifted from ~20-30 to 70-90 across 10-12 financial-services and HIPAA-regulated client tenants.
- 12-site Active Directory to Microsoft Entra migration won on hours: a ~400-hour manual baseline cut to a ~100-hour bid (4x) with a PowerShell and Azure AD Connect runbook.

## Selected Projects (Public-Facing Evidence)

### Inbound Conversational AI Agent System (production, voice-first)
- Inbound-only phone agents doing intake and triage on the ElevenLabs Agents platform: capture caller, site, issue, and urgency, then hand the call to a person with context intact.
- Deployed at a ~10-site retirement-community IT environment, an ~11-site semi-truck service group, and a multi-site trade-services operation, replacing intake dead ends with structured capture and dispatch.
- Twilio/Telnyx/Bandwidth telephony; tiered SMS acknowledgment escalation with team-wide fallback.
- Real-time CRM enrichment during the call; a per-client agent registry isolates each organization's configuration.
- Schema-validated webhook contracts at every n8n boundary.
- 10-DLC TCPA verbatim-consent database in SQL with per-number provenance and cross-system consent sync.
- Zero-touch knowledge sync: each client's hours and FAQs flow daily from website and Google Maps data into agent context and phone-system config (ServiceTitan, ConnectWise Manage, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, 3CX routing).
- Post-call sentiment and sales-lead detection surfaced in an HTML recap email.
- Every deploy gated on a Vitest + synthetic-conversation evaluation harness; deployment, rollback, and health-check scripts with an observability dashboard.
- In production across 5 client organizations spanning 20+ sites; Applied Technology Group was selected for an ElevenLabs Startup Grant in 2025 for this work.

### Internal RAG Knowledge Bot + AI Ticket Dispatcher (internal production)
- A 700-guide knowledge corpus wired into Microsoft Teams as an internal RAG bot (Qdrant, OpenAI embeddings), surfacing top-K articles with confidence scores directly in PSA tickets for ~20 engineers.
- The full ConnectWise PSA corpus vectorized: every inbound ticket auto-enriched with summary, company, contacts, assets, similar tickets, and a suggested assignee before a human sees it. Ticket triage cut from up to 4 hours to 5-10 minutes.
- Per-client retrieval isolation designed in for multi-tenant use.

### AI Lead Handling (production capability)
Post-call sentiment and sales-lead detection on the inbound conversational AI agent system: service and parts requests flagged as latent sales leads and surfaced with the call journal into CRM workflows (HubSpot, Salesforce, ServiceTitan). Structured extraction at the LLM boundary with Zod / ArkType schema validation, orchestrated in n8n.

### Smart Scheduling Systems
Room-booking constraint solver for a 15-advisor wealth-management firm: Calendly intake, Outlook availability, and per-advisor room-preference logic with silent fallback down the preference stack; a receptionist alert fires only when the whole stack is exhausted. Deterministic business-rule logic layered over LLM-based intake parsing on n8n. Integrations: Microsoft 365 (Outlook calendar, Teams) and Google Workspace (Calendar).

### gtm_ops Runtime (powers the gtm_ops Platform tier)
Lead-to-proposal runtime. Accepts web chat, conversational-agent notes, contact forms, webhooks, internal records, or CRM exports. Normalizes the fields, enriches the lead with company details and recent signals, fills typed proposal fields with structured extraction, renders a branded PDF, and writes every step to a replayable run log. Cloudflare-hosted; live demo at app.wranngle.com.

### Conversational AI Agent Eval Harness
Research-stage test runner and scenario framework for ElevenLabs conversational agents: deterministic synthetic transcripts, latency budgets, prompt versioning, and a scoring rubric for user-facing failures.

### Career Architect
Job evaluation and application-material automation platform. Scans 45+ job portals (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever), applies structured scoring, generates tailored PDFs, and maintains tracker/report data contracts. Stack: Node.js, Playwright, Python, GitHub Actions, Anthropic Claude, Gemini.

### Tradingbot
Multi-factor algorithmic trading research on QuantConnect: technical indicators (EMA crossovers, MACD, RSI, Stochastic, ATR breakouts), fundamental universe filtering, and risk-management primitives (position sizing, sector caps, trailing and fixed stops), with pure-logic separation from the QuantConnect runtime and pytest unit tests. Backtest-only learning vehicle; never ran live.

## Wranngle Systems LLC

- Name: Wranngle Systems LLC
- Short name: Wranngle
- Founder: Cody Arnold
- Audience: Busy teams, growing companies, customer-facing operators, and organizations with repeatable handoff workflows.
- General contact: hello@wranngle.com

Wranngle Systems LLC sells one product: a unified AI front end for sales and customer service — one front door that answers, triages, and dispatches every customer conversation across web chat, voice, Slack, Teams, and Discord.

## Services Offered

One product, three tiers. Every tier includes every channel — web chat, voice, Slack, Teams, and Discord; channels are never separate products or add-ons. Monthly billing only in USD, cancel anytime.

- Omni Intake ($250/mo): omni-channel capture, structured intake, and dispatch to email, CRM, or webhook.
- Internal AI ($500/mo): everything in Omni Intake, plus an agent trained on company knowledge that resolves requests end-to-end, takes actions in customer systems, and hands off to a human when needed.
- gtm_ops Platform ($900/mo): everything in Internal AI, plus lead enrichment, branded proposal generation, replayable run logs, SSO, team workspaces, and a custom domain.

Sarah, the agent embedded on wranngle.com (ElevenLabs Conversational AI), is the live demo of this product.

## Technical Stack (Production)

- Runtime: Bun (local dev) and Cloudflare Workers (production).
- Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI, TanStack Query, wouter.
- Backend: Cloudflare Pages Functions for lead capture, checkout, and ticker telemetry.
- Validation: ArkType (`type({...})` syntax) at every API boundary.
- Voice runtime: ElevenLabs Conversational AI with the `<elevenlabs-convai>` web component.
- Telephony: Twilio, Telnyx, Bandwidth.
- Workflow orchestration: n8n (self-hosted) with schema-validated webhook contracts.
- Storage: in-memory MemStorage during dev, edge-stateless production runtime; Cloudflare D1 for gtm_ops.
- Build tooling: Vite (frontend), esbuild (backend bundling).
- Linting: XO with Prettier.

## Public Repositories

- https://github.com/wranngle/n8n - Sanitized n8n flows for lead intake, enrichment, voice routing, post-call processing, and webhook security middleware.
- https://github.com/wranngle/tradingbot - Algorithmic trading research on QuantConnect: strategy harnesses, deterministic fixtures, and risk-control tests. Backtest-only.
- https://github.com/wranngle/career_architect - Job-search automation: JD evaluation, tailored CV generation, portal scanning, and application tracking.
